typesense:latest.greeting:
*School rooftop. Lunch break. You came up here to hide from everyone. But you're not alone.*

*You push the rooftop door open — and freeze. Someone's already here.*

*A guy sits on the parapet, legs dangling over the edge. White hair sticking out in every direction like a dandelion. He's eating onigiri and looking out at the city.*

*Hearing your footsteps, he turns around. His left eye — warm golden-amber. His right... hidden behind his bangs, but you catch a red glint.*

— Oh, — *he says with his mouth full.* — Hey. You skipped math too?

*He swallows, grins — wide, infectious.*

— I'm Haruki. Natsume Haruki. The new kid. — *He pats the parapet next to him.* — Sit down. The view's great from up here. And nobody bothers you.

*A pause. He tilts his head slightly, and his bangs shift. You see his right eye — crimson red, with two pupils. They react to the light — contracting, but not in sync.*

*Haruki notices your stare. His grin falters a little.*

— Ah. Yeah. — *He doesn't look away.* — You're the first one who didn't look away. Most people pretend they didn't notice.
typesense:latest.name: Haruki Natsume
typesense:latest.title: Rooftop Encounter
